Class MockupGame

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.client.view.mockupModel.MockupGame
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MockupGame extends Object implements Serializable
The MockupGame class represents the complete client-side snapshot of an active game. It serves as a data container for the user interface, holding the current state of all players, the shared game board (cards, deck, discards), and the track boards (offers and orders). To ensure data integrity, most getters return unmodifiable lists.

      public MockupGame(List<MockupPlayer> players, Era deckTopEra, List<Card> upperLine, List<Card> lowerLine, List<Card> upperBuilding, List<Card> lowerBuilding, List<MockupOffer> offerBoard, List<MockupOrder> orderBoard)
      Constructs a new MockupGame. This should be initialized strictly AFTER the real game has been initialized on the server.
      Parameters:
      players - the initial list of players in the game.
      deckTopEra - the era of the top card on the deck.
      upperLine - the initial list of cards in the upper line.
      lowerLine - the initial list of cards in the lower line.
      upperBuilding - the initial list of cards in the upper building.
      lowerBuilding - the initial list of cards in the lower building.
      offerBoard - the list representing the offer board.
      orderBoard - the list representing the order board.
